value.title: Limit state on the request store
value.success: role_requests gains checkin_at, escalated_at and answered_at (migration number from pm-001) with a partial index on open limited requests (delivered, limit set, not escalated, not answered). The store lists them in one indexed query and records a check-in, an escalation and an answer, each at most once.
value.notes: answered_at is set by s06 through mark_role_request_answered.

value.title: Check-in and escalation in the watchdog round
value.success: Inside the existing PA watchdog round: for each open limited request, the clock starts at the later of its delivery and its holder's latest card. Past the limit with no check-in, the holder gets one check-in (write what you have, update your card, say why it needs longer), delivered the ordinary way with a cold wake audited. After a check-in, a whole further limit with no card update since it raises one notice to the project's PA (else the prime). Answered requests are skipped. Nothing is stopped.
value.notes: Card = latest report.now, one indexed LIMIT 1 read per open request. Check-in and notice are each one delivery, recorded before sending (persist before mutate).

value.title: Defaults: the role default_limit and an explicit --limit
value.success: Without --limit a role send stores the role's default_limit (C5); an explicit --limit wins; with neither the request has no limit and is never checked in.
value.notes: The default is resolved at send time by s05's route; this task proves it end to end.

value.title: Cost readings
value.success: No new timer or launch site: spawn_sites green; the PR states the round's added cost (one indexed query for open limited requests, plus one LIMIT 1 card read per open request; one delivery per check-in or notice).

value.title: Docs and states
value.success: pij-rs-api.md documents limits, check-ins and notices; roadmap s12 complete with its plan cell, req-22 shipped, c-limits shipped, edited in place; ddocs-check passes; PR body has Delivers:.

tk-0001.assertion: pij-store tests: open limited requests exclude queued, unlimited, escalated and answered ones; check-in, escalation and answer each record once.

tk-0002.assertion: pij-daemon tests: a seat past its limit with no card update gets exactly one check-in over several rounds; a seat that updates its card is never checked in.
An ignored check-in raises exactly one PA notice; a card update after the check-in raises none.

tk-0003.assertion: pij-daemon test: a role with default_limit stores it on a send without --limit; --limit overrides it; a role without one stores none.

tk-0004.assertion: spawn_sites green with no new site; the performance verdict records the at-rest readings.

tk-0005.assertion: ddocs-check green; CI on the exact head; reviewer, security and performance verdicts.
